Networking basics

Q1. Which protocol is connectionless?
A. TCP
B. UDP
C. HTTP
D. FTP
Ans: B

Q2. What does DNS resolve?
(A) IP addresses to MAC addresses
(B) Host names to IP addresses
(C) Ports to services
(D) URLs to files
Answer - b
Explanation: DNS maps names to addresses.

3) Which header carries a bearer token?
A Authorization
B Content-Type
C Accept
D Host
Correct Answer: A
